findings.mechanism: Section tree has parent<->child links, which is the classic Rc cycle shape for a leak.
findings.cause: Parent link is RefCell<Weak<Section>> (set via Rc::downgrade in Section::append); only parent->children edges are strong, so the tree is acyclic in strong refs. The parser's `open` stack and Parsed.root are dropped at the end of Service::handle, freeing the whole tree. Error paths (EmptyTitle/Empty) also drop root. Service holds only two u64 counters; no statics, caches, threads or thread-locals exist.
findings.evidence: Built release and ran with --iterations 1000, 10000, 40000 (40x more documents, ~1.58M headings). Peak RSS (ru_maxrss) stayed at a constant 13504 KB for all three runs, so there is no growth with documents processed.
findings.discriminator: Back-reference is Weak, not Rc, so strong counts reach zero when the root is dropped; peak RSS is flat across 1k/10k/40k documents.
